text: Don't trust your wealth and say, “I don't need anyone's help.
I'm strong and smart enough to get anything I want,
and no one has the power to make me obey.” Talk like that, and God will punish you!
And don't reply, “I sinned, but God didn't punish me.” God was being patient.
Never be so sure of his forgiveness that you keep on sinning
and say, “God is very kind, and he will forgive me even though I sin a lot.” Yes, God is kind, but he also gets angry and punishes sinners.
Turn back to the Lord now— don't wait until tomorrow. If he gets angry, he will quickly punish you with death.
And wealth gained by cheating won't save you from disaster.
Not every wind is good for blowing away husks from threshed grain. And not every path leads where you want to go. But sinners will say anything to get what they want.[14]
Stand up for what you believe, and don't change what you say from one time to the next.
Be willing to listen to anyone, but think before you answer.
Then speak up, if you know what to say; and if not, just keep quiet.
Your words can bring you honor, but they can also cause your ruin and disgrace.
When you speak, don't tear others down or try to make them say something wrong. You would receive severe punishment, far worse than the shame felt by thieves.
